description: Saves a series the person approved: its name, what it's about and for whom, what every episode is made with (kind, look, voice, length, tone, music, language) and the episodes in order (title, first line, angle, points). Episodes are added after any the series already has. It shows in their Fuzzframe videos as a series. When they chose their previous settings, pass same_as_last. Free. Then make episode 1 here (start_video or start_story with series and episode), and tell them each later episode is best made in a new chat: "make the next episode of <name>".

about.description: What the series is, in one line

audience.description: Who it is for and what they already know

episodes.description: The episodes in order, each with its title, first line, angle and points

angle.description: Why it's interesting: the twist or the payoff

language.description: The language every episode is written and narrated in

look.description: motion: a look id from looks (or my-… from save_look); story: a story look id

music.description: The kind of music and how it's described, in plain words

name.description: The series' name, as it shows in their videos

same_as_last.description: true when they chose their previous settings: every field left empty takes what their last finished video was made with

tone.description: The tone every episode is told in, in a few words

voice_id.description: The voice every episode is narrated in, from the voices tool

voice_name.description: That voice's name, as the voices tool lists it

name: plan_series
title: Save a series plan
